# Social Frames

> Social Frames is a free library of copy-ready SVG frames for social media. Pick a format, copy the SVG, paste it into Figma, Sketch, or any design tool. 11 platforms, 60 formats, no signup.

URL: https://socialframes.app/

## What this site answers

- What size is an Instagram Story? 1080 x 1920 px (9:16). Reels use the same frame.
- What size is an Instagram post? 1080 x 1350 px (4:5) fills the most screen; 1080 x 1440 px (3:4) matches the new grid crop.
- What size is a YouTube thumbnail? 3840 x 2160 px (4K, 16:9) is recommended; 1280 x 720 px is the accepted minimum.
- What size is a YouTube channel banner? 2560 x 1440 px, with the safe area for text at 1546 x 423 px in the center.
- What size is a LinkedIn banner? 1584 x 396 px personal, 1128 x 191 px company page.
- What size is a TikTok video? 1080 x 1920 px (9:16).
- What size is a Facebook cover photo? 820 x 312 px desktop, 640 x 360 px mobile.
- What size is a Snapchat geofilter? 1080 x 2340 px.
- What size is an Open Graph image? 1200 x 630 px.

## Main pages

- [Social Frames home](https://socialframes.app/): search all 60 formats, browse platforms, full size guide
- [Instagram templates](https://socialframes.app/instagram-templates): story, reel, feed, profile and cover sizes
- [YouTube templates](https://socialframes.app/youtube-templates): thumbnail, banner, shorts and podcast sizes
- [X templates](https://socialframes.app/x-templates): header, post and card sizes
- [Facebook templates](https://socialframes.app/facebook-templates): cover, event, group and post sizes
- [LinkedIn templates](https://socialframes.app/linkedin-templates): banner, post and article cover sizes
- [TikTok templates](https://socialframes.app/tiktok-templates): video, carousel and profile sizes
- [Pinterest templates](https://socialframes.app/pinterest-templates): pin, idea pin and board cover sizes
- [Threads templates](https://socialframes.app/threads-templates): post, carousel and profile sizes
- [Bluesky templates](https://socialframes.app/bluesky-templates): header and post sizes
- [Snapchat templates](https://socialframes.app/snapchat-templates): story, geofilter and profile sizes
- [Web and Open Graph templates](https://socialframes.app/og-image-templates): OG image, favicon and touch icon sizes

## How to use the frames

Every frame is a plain SVG sized to the exact pixel dimensions of the target platform. Copy it from any platform page and paste it into your design tool as a frame, artboard, or selection guide. All frames are free, with no account required.
